summary: Build practical skills in gender analysis, economic inclusion, and results tracking. Explore the five-day course and request details.
lede: Gender and economic development analysis helps policy analysts, programme managers, and practitioners assess how gender shapes access to work, income, finance, and markets. The course applies the Moser framework and ILOSTAT indicators to map constraints, interpret labour and enterprise data, build an Excel dashboard, and develop gender-responsive interventions, budgeting, monitoring, and reporting plans. It also addresses unpaid care, value-chain participation, and validation of AI-assisted analysis.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape, fund, deliver, measure, or report economic policies and programmes with gender equality objectives.
modules: Women’s Economic Empowerment in Value Chains
CEDAW and ILO Standards in Policy
Gender at Work Framework and Action Planning
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Some experience in economic development, gender equality, public policy, programme delivery, monitoring and evaluation, or a related role. Basic spreadsheet literacy will support the Excel indicator exercise. Coding or programming is not required. Advanced topics such as AI-assisted analysis are introduced for operational awareness, not technical implementation.
